high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a news article or report from the Financial Times (FT), as indicated by the copyright symbol and the author's name, John Burn-Murdoch, at the bottom. The time displayed on the phone screen is 4:58, and the status bar shows LTE connectivity and battery level. The main content of the image is a graph titled "Young adults' personalities are changing, with conscientiousness in freefall." It discusses the relative change in strength of different personality traits over time, specifically comparing three age groups: 16-39, 40-59, and 6
